name: Cerema DVF+ Open Data
description: Official French property-sale transactions from the Cerema DVF+ open-data API. Search mutations by commune, small bounding box, date, property type, area, or sale value, with optional GeoJSON geometry. DVF identifies what sold, where, when, and for how much; it does not expose buyer or seller identity. The Cerema API is currently beta.

tools.name: search_mutations
tools.description: Search DVF+ property transactions and return normalized mutation rows. A location constraint is expected: one or more INSEE commune codes, a small bounding box, or a point. Use ordering=-datemut to prioritize the newest recorded sales.

code_insee.description: One INSEE commune code or up to ten comma-separated codes.

in_bbox.description: Small WGS84 bounding box `west,south,east,north`; API maximum width/height is approximately 0.02 degrees.

contains_geom.description: WGS84 point `longitude,latitude`; return transactions whose geometry contains it.

anneemut.description: Exact transaction year in YYYY format.

codtypbien.description: DVF+ property-type code, for example 111 for a house or 121 for an apartment.

sbati_min.description: Minimum built floor area in square metres.

sbati_max.description: Maximum built floor area in square metres.

sterr_min.description: Minimum land area in square metres.

sterr_max.description: Maximum land area in square metres.

fields.description: Use `all` to request every available field.

tools.name: search_geomutations
tools.description: Search DVF+ transactions with their GeoJSON geometries. Use this for parcel mapping and spatial joins; use search_mutations when geometry is not needed.

code_insee.description: One INSEE commune code or comma-separated codes.
